item.title: Council Responds to Surge in Potholes

item.title: Scam Warning Issued Over Fake Arthritis Charity Calls
item.description: Leicestershire Trading Standards has issued a warning after reports of scammers impersonating the charity Arthritis UK. Fraudsters are contacting people by phone claiming they are eligible for help completing benefits forms — but only if they pay a fee. item.description: Financial concerns continue at Harborough District Council after external auditors declined to sign off its accounts for the second year running. item.title: County Council Abandons Plans to Close SEND Nurseries
item.description: Leicestershire County Council has abandoned plans to close nurseries for children with special educational needs and disabilities (SEND) following widespread opposition.
